_source: Gregory, Webber, Wanless and Page, J. Phys. Chem. A 123, 6420 (2019), doi:10.1021/acs.jpca.9b04004, Figure 4. Free energies of interaction (kcal/mol) between dissociated ions and a NIPAM monomer, averaged over 10 configurations. The paper gives these only as a plot (a 300 ppi raster, with no table in the paper or its SI), so each value was read by eye from magnified crops of the figure with a 1 kcal/mol grid (see lewis_digitise.py for the axis calibration). Where markers overlap, values are good to about +/- 0.5 kcal/mol; elsewhere about +/- 0.3. 'bound' = panels a and b (no desolvation penalty); 'effective' = panels c and d (with the penalty of removing one solvent molecule from the ion's shell). Cations bind at the C=O oxygen, anions at the amide N-H.
